name: With rugs: the MORABO sofa with chaise and two POÄNG chairs with their ottomans around a walnut UGGLERUM, the chaise by the stairs
notes:
Later on 2026-10-26 Andrew's cart added the IKEA PS LÖMSK children's swivel armchair with its shark slipcover: it takes the window corner of the play wall in place of the SMÅSTAD reading bench (a storage piece, Saturday's decision), x 237.75-261, y 18-42.375, 18" from the heater's drawn face (F-33), under the UPPLYST cloud lamp and the VARPTROSS reading light, 14" above the TROFAST; the route along the window ends at it. Recommended for 3 and older (F-21).
With rugs, the alternative since the evening of 2026-10-26 (Andrew: "we are going with rugless for allergy conerns, wife wins."): the room as it was staged until then, with its rugs; the rug-free room is a.
Staged pick, re-staged 2026-10-26 on Andrew's IKEA cart: the MORABO Sofa with chaise ($1,199, one article: a loveseat frame and a chaise section) in place of the U (the 5-seat corner and the chaise add-on, $2,449; f keeps that room), facing the window as before with the chaise at the stairs end; the play area and the lamps are unchanged, and the floor between the sofa's end and the play rug opens to 56.5". Later that evening, on his word ("FOr the coffee table I want a rectangular one"; "consider a lvoeat / chair with legrest"), the oval VALNÄS gave way to the rectangular walnut UGGLERUM, and a chair with legrest took the floor beside the sofa; then his word on the POÄNG ottoman ("type of footrest is perfect, just make sure you pair it with the right chair. We can have 2 sets !"): two POÄNG armchairs with their ottomans, one beside the sofa facing the window and one north of it facing the sofa across the table; the SKULNÄS recliner is g and a second sofa, the loveseat, h. No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). The sofa is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22): Andrew can't tape the stairs before the move (2026-10-26, F-07). It is in his cart to order on 2026-10-26, his call: its boxes are the loveseat frame's, 69 x 37 x 21" at 115 lb 12 oz, and the chaise section's, 64 1/2 x 32 1/4 x 21 1/2" at 69 lb 4 oz, each smaller than the U's corner frame (78 1/2 x 36 3/4 x 20 1/4"); the cart page says returns within 365 days.
His pick (2026-10-26) over the largest that fits: the MORABO Sofa with chaise, 96 1/8" across and 62 1/4" deep at the chaise, three seats (IKEA counts the chaise as one) around the VALNÄS, floating with its back on the open side's walkway edge and facing the window. The U it replaces (141 3/4 x 95 1/4", f) took the floor to x 177.75; this sofa ends at x 132.125, so the open floor between it and the play rug is 56.5" (it was 10.9" beside the U's arm); the first POÄNG and its ottoman now hold 26 3/4" of that floor, 18" off the sofa's end and 11.9" short of the play rug's LÄTT.
sofa-1 MORABO Sofa with chaise, rot 180, x 36-132.125, y 80.75-143: the loveseat part (x 66.75-132.125, y 106.75-143) faces the window with the 30" walkway behind it (F-39, F-42); the chaise (x 36-66.75, the full 62 1/4") at the stairs end, on the edge of the railing's 36" strip (F-40), its lounger toward the window, its foot 74.75" from the heater face (F-33); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22). The chaise section can be built on either end (the loose armrest goes on its outer side); drawn on the right seen from the front, by the stairs, so the loveseat's end is toward the play floor and from the seats you see Maddie past it. D turns the same sofa to face the play area.
coffee-table-1 UGGLERUM walnut veneer, 51 1/8 x 25 5/8 x 16 7/8" (floor), x 80.75-131.875, y 65.125-90.75: 16" from the loveseat's front and 14" from the chaise's side (F-39), its far end flush with the sofa's end; 78% of the seat section's 65 3/8", and 1 5/8" below the 18 1/2" seat. Rectangular, as Andrew asked (2026-10-26), so its corners sit at a 4-year-old's head height: corner guards on the play-side end (F-21). The seats are reached through the 14" gap at the chaise or past the ottoman, as at any coffee table. armchair-1 POÄNG armchair, birch veneer/Knisa light beige, 26 3/4 x 32 1/4 x 39 3/8" (floor): beside the sofa's play-side end, rot 180, x 150-176.75, y 110.75-143, facing the window, its back on the walkway edge like the sofa's (F-42), 18" off the sofa's end, which is the way in to the seats from the play side (the 16" strip between the table and the seats); ottoman-1 POÄNG ottoman, 26 3/4 x 21 1/4 x 15 3/8" (floor): its footrest, rot 180, x 150-176.75, y 85.5-106.75, 4" in front of the seat. armchair-2 POÄNG (floor): north of the first, rot 270, x 134-166.25, y 36-62.75, facing west toward the sofa's seats and the chaise across the table, 30" from the heater's drawn face, so the route along the window keeps its 30" (F-30; F-33's 18" for upholstery met), 22.75" above the first chair's ottoman; ottoman-2 POÄNG ottoman (floor): rot 270, x 108.75-130, y 36-62.75, 4" in front of its seat, on the rug's east edge, 2 3/8" north of the table. Andrew's "chair with legrest" (2026-10-26): first a MORABO armchair with its ottoman, then his word on the POÄNG ottoman, "type of footrest is perfect, just make sure you pair it with the right chair. We can have 2 sets !", so two POÄNG sets ($229 each) in the sofa's beige and birch, the master bedroom's reading chair's twins; the SKULNÄS recliner is g and the loveseat as a second sofa h; the MORABO armchair and ottoman are not placed.
wall-lamp-3 VARPTROSS (top), on the window wall at x 50-57: the group's lamp on the wall, a soft glow (5.9 W), with the ceiling light and the lamp on the VALNÄS for reading; its cord in a cover down the wall to an outlet above the heater, never across it (final audit 2026-10-26: the TÅGARP that stood here, 16.5" off the wall, could reach a window-wall outlet only with its 3' 3" cord lying over the heater, F-33). plant-1 FEJKA bird of paradise at the chaise's foot on the stairs side, x 37-46, y 71.5-80.5, 1" off the railing strip (F-40) and 65" from the heater's drawn face, in no route. The play corner's UPPLYST, the VARPTROSS over the BESTÅ and wall-lamp-4, a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench as its reading light (final audit 2026-10-26), light the right side.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", turned, x 36-130, y 25-143: under the whole sofa with chaise and the table, its south edge on the walkway's edge and its west edge on the railing strip's edge, 19" from the heater's drawn face (F-33); the armchair and ottoman stand on the floor beside it, their own zone; two STOPP FILT underlays keep it put. Its page says "Do not wash" and never a rotating brush: the jute can't take the robot vacuum the open base was chosen for (F-67), so give the robot a no-go zone over it, or swap it for a washable flatweave of about 118 x 94" (none in the catalog).
Play area (F-61), as staged before: toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner (x 240.5-261, y 18-53.4) with wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST over it; toy-storage-1 TROFAST below it (x 243.6-261, y 56.4-93), 24" clear in front (F-32), art-1 PJÄTTERYD above; toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ with doors on the right-lower wall (x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142), its FLISAT book display on top and wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS above, art-2 RÖDALM; rug-3 LEN play rug (x 183-235, y 75-138), 53" of bare floor from the TIOKRONA; kids-table-1 LÄTT and its two chairs on it (x 188.6-213.4, y 98-116.9), 14.75" past the armchair (a dead gap) and 30.7" on the diagonal from its corner to the TROFAST's corner (243.6, 93), the way from the kitchen side to the play wall, which runs east of it (F-30).
Walkways: the open side's walkway (F-42), the first chair's back on its edge like the sofa's; the route along the window from the top landing to the play corner, 74.75" wide at the chaise's foot and 30" between the heater's drawn face and the second chair (F-30, F-40); the way in to the sofa's seats, 14" at the chaise and 18" between the table and the first ottoman; from the kitchen side up to the play wall east of the LÄTT, 45" to the BESTÅ and 30.7" past the TROFAST's corner (F-30); the 11.9" between the first chair and the LÄTT and the 22.75" between the two chairs are reaches, not routes; the bottom landing onto the walkway; the sofa and the chair open toward the window. Nowhere to set a cup from the chaise (the table is 29" from its lounger): a clip-on tray over the chaise's arm would do it without taking floor (not in the catalog); the second chair sits at the table's corner.
Not placed: the MORABO U, the 5-seat corner and the chaise add-on (f: the largest that fits, until Andrew's cart chose this sofa); the KIVIK sofa (rejected: no chaise, no open base, F-67); the VALNÄS (oval; Andrew wants a rectangle, 2026-10-26) and the LACK 46 1/2 x 30 3/4" (the budget rectangle); the MORABO armchair and ottoman (the sofa's own fabric, but Andrew wants the POÄNG footrest, 2026-10-26); the SKULNÄS recliner (g) and the loveseat (h); the LACK console and its STORSEGEL (it stood against the old sofa's back, now on the walkway edge) and the side table with its STORSEGEL (no wall beside the U for a lamp's cord); the TÅGARPs (one stood by the window until the final audit 2026-10-26, its cord over the heater; the other, right of the window, in front of the reading bench); the TV and its units (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21).
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the heater runs the whole window wall, so a cord to an outlet there must come down the wall in a cover from a wall lamp, never across the heater from a floor lamp (final audit 2026-10-26: the TÅGARP came off for that reason), and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; the FLISAT book display stands on the 15" BESTÅ, 31" together, so fix it to the wall; nothing else is over 27"; the VARPTROSS hangs out of her reach. The UGGLERUM's corners are at her head height: corner guards on its play-side end.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1, SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, LÖVA canopy x1 over the reading bench, STOPP FILT underlays x2 (under the TIOKRONA).
Total $3,074.76: placed $2,796.86 + extras $277.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26 (those before today price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the LÄTT moved 11.4" west, so the way from the kitchen side to the play wall is 30.7" (both ways past it were under 30": 22.25" beside the U's arm and 19.5" to the TROFAST's corner), the LEN with it, and the TIOKRONA 9" west so the whole chaise stands on it; the TÅGARP became a VARPTROSS on the window wall, since its cord would have crossed the heater to reach any outlet there (F-33); a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench is the play wall's reading light.
